videos.title: The Security Camera Showed Someone Behind Him
videos.topic: A night-shift security guard keeps seeing a figure on the lobby camera standing behind him, until he learns the camera feed is a live view of the building's empty twin across the street, and the figure is watching him through the real window.
videos.genre: creepy short fiction with a twist ending (clearly fiction)

videos.title: The Ship Found Sailing With Nobody Aboard
videos.topic: The 1872 discovery of the Mary Celeste, a ship found drifting in the Atlantic with no one on board, and the unsolved question of why everyone left.

videos.title: 28 Men, One Lifeboat, and the Impossible Rescue
videos.topic: After their ship Endurance was crushed by Antarctic ice in 1915, Shackleton and five men sailed a lifeboat to South Georgia to get help, and every man of the expedition survived.

videos.title: The Pig That Nearly Started a War Between Two Empires
videos.topic: The 1859 Pig War on San Juan Island, where a shot pig nearly started a war between the United States and Britain, and no one died but the pig
videos.genre: strange but true moment from history (well documented)

videos.title: He Was Supposed to Tow the Car. Then He Saw the Cake.
videos.topic: A tow truck driver about to haul away a car finds a birthday cake inside, lets the mother go, and is moved to call his estranged daughter.
videos.genre: heartwarming short fiction about an unexpected act of kindness

videos.title: The Hotel Elevator That Stopped on Floor Fourteen
videos.topic: An urban legend about a night-shift elevator operator who keeps getting a call from a floor that doesn't exist in an old downtown hotel
videos.genre: eerie urban-legend style tale (presented as legend, not fact)

videos.title: The Knocking Inside the Locked Lighthouse Room
videos.topic: A night-shift lighthouse keeper keeps hearing knocks from inside the locked lamp room, and discovers the knocking is a warning that he is the one who has been trapped all along.
videos.genre: creepy short fiction with a twist ending (clearly fiction)

videos.title: The 72-Second Signal From Space That Never Came Back
videos.topic: The Wow! signal: a strong 72-second radio signal detected by Ohio's Big Ear telescope in 1977 that has never been heard again

videos.title: 33 Miners Trapped 700 Meters Down. Then Came the Note.
videos.topic: The 2010 Chilean mine collapse, where 33 miners survived 69 days underground and were all rescued alive

videos.title: The Time the Army Lost a War to Emus
videos.topic: The Great Emu War of 1932, when the Australian military was sent with machine guns to stop emus ruining Western Australian wheat farms, and the birds outmaneuvered them.
videos.genre: strange but true moment from history (well documented)

videos.title: The Girl Who Rode the Night Bus Every Night
videos.topic: A night-shift bus driver notices a teenage girl riding the whole route to stay warm, and quietly changes her night with one small act.
videos.genre: heartwarming short fiction about an unexpected act of kindness

videos.title: The Payphone That Rang Once, Then Saved a Trucker
videos.topic: A trucker's legend about a phantom payphone at a closed gas station that rings to warn drivers away from a bridge that is about to fail.
videos.genre: eerie urban-legend style tale (presented as legend, not fact)

videos.title: The Postcards Kept Getting Closer to Her Bedroom
videos.topic: A woman receives daily postcards of her own house, each taken from closer, until one shows her bedroom closet and is postmarked with tomorrow's date.
videos.genre: creepy short fiction with a twist ending (clearly fiction)
